response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_invoice_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_quantity, i.relative_gap, i.avg_quantity - o.avg_invoice_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.avg_invoice_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference IS NULL, quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10
